categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in digital transformation services focusing on three strategic business segments: big data/artificial intelligence, domestic database products, and satellite internet. Additional segments include IoT products and technical development and services. The business model revolves around providing digital transformation products and integrated solutions to government, energy, telecom operators, finance, and transportation sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include intelligent big data fusion platforms, proprietary large language models (Grz Model), cloud-edge integrated intelligent platforms, and a suite of database products such as GreatDB centralized and distributed databases with advanced query engines. The company also develops satellite internet technologies covering space, ground, and user segments, including 5G wireless communication core technologies. Manufacturing and development emphasize full-stack autonomous control, compatibility with mainstream chips, and integration of AI, big data, and cloud computing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are telecom operators, large enterprises, government departments, and the State Grid and its subsidiaries. The company serves high-value industries including government, energy, telecom, finance, transportation, and healthcare. The markets are primarily domestic with a focus on regional government projects, smart city initiatives, and digital infrastructure modernization.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with strategic hubs in Chengdu (headquarters), Beijing, Shanghai, Guangdong, and Shaanxi. It also has market presence in provinces such as Yunnan, Guizhou, Guangxi, Hainan, Shanxi, Henan, Hubei, and Jiangsu. Overseas operations include subsidiaries in Hong Kong, Cambodia, and Malaysia.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the IT and telecommunications supply chain. It develops and integrates software and hardware products, provides system integration, software development, and technical services, and delivers end-to-end solutions for digital transformation and satellite internet applications.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening integration of big data and AI technologies, advancing domestic database capabilities, and expanding satellite internet product lines. R&D focuses on AI model development, data governance, edge computing, and 5G/low-earth orbit satellite communication technologies. The company emphasizes autonomous innovation, ecosystem collaboration with academia and industry, and expanding AI application scenarios in vertical industries.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales (database software, AI platforms, satellite internet equipment), technical development and services (system integration, software development, maintenance), and comprehensive digital transformation solutions. Sales channels include direct sales, regional agents, and public bidding. The company also earns investment income from equity holdings.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading domestic digital transformation service provider and MySQL domestic replacement leader in the database sector. It competes in big data, AI, and satellite internet markets with a focus on autonomous technology and ecosystem development. Competitors include other domestic IT service providers and database vendors, with the company leveraging its full-stack technology and government/enterprise client base to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.41 billion, a 16.08% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 78.86 million, showing an 83.38% reduction in loss compared to 2023. The company has total assets of about RMB 3.12 billion and equity of RMB 1.84 billion. Despite losses, cash flow from operations improved significantly. The company is undergoing restructuring and focusing on sustainable growth through technology and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes full-stack autonomous and controllable technology platforms, including proprietary AI large models, high-performance domestic databases with superior query engines, and end-to-end satellite internet solutions. Its differentiation lies in deep integration of AI and big data with industry-specific applications, strong ecosystem partnerships, and comprehensive digital transformation capabilities tailored to government and enterprise clients. The company also highlights its ability to provide secure, compatible, and scalable solutions supporting national strategies like data sovereignty and digital China.
